map.初始投资 100000 元，第 1~5 年净现金流分别为 25000、30000: Initial investment 100000 CNY, with year 1~5 net cash flows of 25000, 30000, 35000, 30000 and 20000 CNY, discounted at 8%. The present value factors 1/(1.08)^t are 0.9259, 0.8573, 0.7938, 0.7350 and 0.6806 in turn; the total present value is about 25000×0.9259 + 30000×0.8573 + 35000×0.7938 + 30000×0.7350 + 20000×0.6806 = 23148 + 25719 + 27783 + 22050 + 13612 = 112312 CNY; net present value NPV = 112312 − 100000 = 12312 CNY, greater than zero, so the plan is feasible.

When comparing a batch of plans, the same discount rate must be used for comparability.
